title: Her Little Fern
lines: Pam has a little fern in a pot.
She sets her fern on the top step.
Then a herd of big pigs runs past.
The pigs bump her fern off the step.
Her fern lands flat in the mud.
Pam is sad and her chin drops.
Dad helps her fill the pot back up.
She pats the mud in with her hands.
Pam sets her fern on the table.
The herd can not get it up there.

questions.ask: What knocked the fern off the step?
questions.listenFor: The herd of pigs running past. If they say 'the pigs' that is right, and you can ask how many.
He helped her fill the pot back up, and she patted the mud in. Listen for both hands doing the job, not just Dad.

questions.ask: Why do you think Pam put the fern on the table at the end?
questions.listenFor: Any answer with a reason. The last line hints that the pigs cannot reach it up there.
